import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_26/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_26/training_1.csv"

Source3_26_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
Source3_26_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source3_26_0 and Source3_26_1 on "movie_id"
joined_df = pd.merge(Source3_26_0, Source3_26_1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by Source3_26_1.title, aggregation avg(Source3_26_0.rating)
result = joined_df.groupby("title", as_index=False)["rating"].mean()

# Rename columns to match target schema: ['title': string, '0': float]
result.rename(columns={"rating": "0"}, inplace=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_26/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_26/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_26/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_26/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_26_0 and Source3_26_1 on movie_id
join_01 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Join the above result with Source3_26_2 on user_id
join_012 = pd.merge(join_01, source2, on="user_id", how="inner")

# Group by title and aggregate average rating
result = join_012.groupby("title", as_index=False).agg({"rating": "mean"})

# Rename columns to match target schema
result.columns = ["title", "0"]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_26/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
